text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Sigh...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I'm out with Sakura Bakushin O during
one of our
days off, but she seems to be
distracted by
something.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
...One of my classmates is leaving the
academy.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
I'm really going to miss her, both as class

representative and as a friend...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
One characteristic of the academy is that

students frequently come and go.
Despite that, it
still isn't easy to part
ways.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Wait? Is that...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
A student wearing a tracksuit runs right
past us.
She appears to heading toward
the academy.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
That's the classmate I was just talking
about! She
shouldn't be training at this
time of night...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
I can't allow it as a class representative!
Stop right
there!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
It's already late, so you had better head
back. I
can't overlook someone breaking
curfew!

text_block_list.name: Freckled Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Ah, I know I'm breaking the rules. But I
don't have
much more time!

text_block_list.name: Freckled Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
I'm leaving the academy because my
father is
being transferred overseas for
work...

text_block_list.name: Freckled Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
So, for my final race—well, final
scrimmage—I
want to practice as hard as
I can so I don't leave
with any regrets.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Your final race...

text_block_list.name: Freckled Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
I didn't have much talent and didn't
even have a
trainer... But I want to go
out on a race I feel
satisfied with!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
I see. I understand how you feel. And
I've made
up my mind!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
From this moment forward, I—as class

representative—will assist with your
training!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Is that all right, Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Oh, that's right! Your training begins
tomorrow!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
With my help and my trainer's guidance,
you'll
definitely take first place!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The next day, I help Sakura Bakushin O
train her
classmate.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Her classmate informs me that she's
racing in a
long-distance scrimmage,
which is Sakura
Bakushin O's greatest
weakness.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
All I can do is give it the ol' Bakushin try!

Bakushin will light the way!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She gives the answer I expected. The
answer I
feared. And so...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I explain how endurance and stamina are
essential
for completing the track and
succeeding in a
long-distance race.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
I see! It's definitely impossible to
Bakushin if you
lack the energy to do so!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
I understand! Let's see it through to the
end!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Huff, huff... Whew... Okay! That's... enough for today!

text_block_list.name: Freckled Umamusume
text_block_list.text: Thanks, Baku! You too, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Freckled Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
I really feel like I got somewhere in
today's
training. I'll definitely make sure
to leave a good
final impression!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: That's... all... that matters...

text_block_list.name: Freckled Umamusume
text_block_list.text: B-Baku?! Did... Did she fall asleep?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Being that she's a sprinter, the
long-distance
training has clearly taken
its toll.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
However, she pushed herself beyond her
limits to
help train her classmate.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Snore... I was merely... doing my job. Yawn...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
As I watch her sleep, I notice a small
smile of
satisfaction on her face.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I explain how a dash of speed at a
critical
moment could help her fly up
into the lead.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
I see! So my Bakushin is like a secret
finisher!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
One needs to wait and find the right
timing to
Bakushin!

text_block_list.name: Freckled Umamusume
text_block_list.text: Okay, I got it!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
To train her, I first need to understand
the
abilities and running tendencies of
Sakura
Bakushin O's classmate.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I devise a training schedule tailored to
what we're
dealing with and have both
of them participate.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Okay, let's finish for today!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
I think you've really nailed the perfect
timing to
Bakushin thanks to this
training!

text_block_list.name: Freckled Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! Thanks to that, I really feel like I
got a
hang of it! I'll definitely deliver
results!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
I'm expecting a great show! Bakushin will
solve
everything!

text_block_list.name: Freckled Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Hehe! Thanks! You always help me out,
Baku.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Naturally! I am the class representative
after all!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It seems that being appreciated by a
fellow
classmate helps to raise Sakura
Bakushin O's
confidence.
